data.description: Captured 2026-09-04 during the session-notification brainstorm (epic allstar-holy-hairstreak). DEFERRED: beyond notification scope. The epic ships only a stale_claim inbox notification for ops-alert tickets (flag-only, 4h, no auto-release). Research conclusions to carry: every incident tool answers 'acknowledger vanished' (PagerDuty ack timeout re-triggers, Icinga ack expiry, k8s Lease renew); rebar's claim is an un-timed soft lock with no inverse op (release = transition back to open). Critique verdict: auto-release and heartbeats are wrong for LLM sessions (review-plan 15-20 min, make verify 25 min, /rebar-implement hours are legitimately silent; heartbeats amplify commit rate on the tickets branch). Recommended shape: an explicit release op (the honest inverse of claim) plus flag-only staleness at 24h for general tickets.
data.title: Explicit claim release/yield op + stale-claim policy for time-sensitive tickets
